items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: All three of the bass players were into jolly. I had a lot of fun with all of them.

ctx.x: Well we ought to check into that.

Yeah you should. You going to play that other record for me? Sure. Oh I want to hear that, Beaufort will be. All those jolly guys, man. All three of the bass players were into jolly. I had a lot of fun with all of them.
Where were they from? Where was Beaufort from?
